parent.reuse: The six sealed A2 W/T4 and W/Z4 source runs remain the no-mixing parent cells; they are never rewritten.

intervention.unit_quotas: size matched to the anchor N; three quotas differ by at most one
intervention.bad_match_policy: fall back to the byte-identical ordinary anchor example if either donor exceeds the residual threshold
intervention.unit_binding: a selected unit's neural query, M30 calibration tensor, and T4/Z4 row always move together
intervention.final_unit_order: one deterministic common permutation is applied to neural, calibration, and side rows
intervention.target: the anchor session's original behavior window
intervention.anchor_sampling: unchanged A2 SessionBatchSampler; pseudo-session mixing does not rebalance anchor-session exposure
intervention.validation_and_deployment: ordinary unmixed A2 data and frozen target-time protocol

stage_p_routing.absolute_accuracy_gate: external sub-M mean-session R2(mix_t4_s42) - sealed A2 T4_s42 >= +0.03
stage_p_routing.within_noninferiority_gate: within sub-C mean-session R2(mix_t4_s42) - sealed A2 T4_s42 >= -0.03
stage_p_routing.mechanism_report: report [(mix_t4-base_t4)-(mix_z4-base_z4)] on each domain, but do not let a collapsing mix_z4 create an accuracy pass
stage_p_routing.fail: stop after two fresh cells; no probability, contributor, threshold, or architecture tuning

accuracy_effective: median of the 15 seed-averaged session deltas > 0
at least 10 of 15 seed-averaged external session deltas > 0
terminal_read_after_three_seeds.generic_augmentation: accuracy_effective passes but carrier_specific fails because mix_z4 improves similarly
terminal_read_after_three_seeds.statistics: report per-seed and per-session values plus crossed seed-by-session bootstrap; no seed-level Wilcoxon at n=3

interpretation_boundaries.h1_priority: deferred until a non-H1 mechanism is established; later use phase-conditioned matching rather than raw 7-DoF nearest neighbors
